title: Emulated sRGB encode applied to premultiplied colour before a premultiplied-alpha blend (FL0)
expected_finding: fsMain premultiplies the linear base colour by alpha (premultiplied output for the ONE / ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA blend) and then applies pow(rgb, 0.4545) to the premultiplied value, giving encode(c) * pow(a, 0.4545) instead of encode(c) * a; with a = 0.047 the overlay's contribution is ~5x too strong
